notablePrerequisites:
Mondrak has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least two additional permanents.
description:
Activate Mondrak using Myojin of Blooming Dawn's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens for each permanent you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Spirits, adding {3}.
Activate Mondrak by paying {3} and sacrificing two Spirits, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.
